Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner reversed the chronological comparison in the final synthesis. Despite collected evidence showing Robert Bresson died on December 18, 1999 and Franco Rossi died on June 5, 2000, the Planner concluded “Franco Rossi died earlier,” contradicting the verified dates and even its own earlier correct interim conclusion. This logical inconsistency led to the wrong film selection.
